milestones.name: Form the Four Light Warriors
milestones.when: Confirm Fighter, Thief, White Mage, Black Mage and start game
milestones.then: Party enters Coneria at (16, 21) with 400 Gold

milestones.name: Talk to the Coneria Town Guard
milestones.when: Walk to the Coneria gate villager at (18, 20) and talk
milestones.then: Villager welcomes the Light Warriors to Coneria, the dream city

milestones.name: Buy & Equip Weapons at Coneria Weapon Shop
milestones.when: Walk to Coneria Weapon Shop at (11, 10) and buy Rapier & Hammer
milestones.then: Fighter equips Rapier and White Mage equips Hammer

milestones.name: Buy & Equip Chain Mail at Coneria Armor Shop
milestones.when: Walk to Coneria Armor Shop at (6, 10) and buy Chain Mail
milestones.then: Fighter equips Chain Mail (+15 DEF) and Thief equips Leather Armor

milestones.name: Learn CURE & RUSE at Coneria White Magic Shop
milestones.when: Walk to Coneria White Magic Shop at (7, 4) and learn Lv1 White Magic
milestones.then: White Mage learns CURE and RUSE

milestones.name: Learn FIRE & LIT at Coneria Black Magic Shop
milestones.when: Walk to Coneria Black Magic Shop at (3, 4) and learn Lv1 Black Magic
milestones.then: Black Mage learns FIRE and LIT

milestones.name: Exit Coneria and Enter Coneria Castle 1F
milestones.when: Walk south out of Coneria (16, 24) onto Overworld and enter Coneria Castle at (41, 48)

milestones.name: Ascend to Throne Room and Hear the King's Quest
milestones.when: Climb stairs at (12, 18) to ConeriaCastle2F, walk to (12, 5), and talk to King of Coneria
milestones.then: King implores the Light Warriors to rescue Princess Sara from Garland

milestones.name: March Across Overworld & Win IMP Encounter
milestones.when: Exit Coneria Castle, battle IMP on the northwest road, and enter Temple of Fiends at (18, 11)
milestones.then: Party defeats Overworld IMP and enters TempleOfFiends at (20, 29)

milestones.name: Loot HEAL Potion & CABIN Chests in Northwest Wing
milestones.when: Walk to northwest treasure room (3, 3) and (2, 3) and open chests
milestones.then: Party obtains HEAL Potion and CABIN from Temple of Fiends chests

milestones.name: Loot Leather Cap Chest in Southwest Wing
milestones.when: Walk to southwest treasure room (2, 32) and open chest
milestones.then: Party obtains Cap from Temple of Fiends chest

milestones.name: Confront and Defeat Garland in the Inner Sanctum
milestones.when: Walk through center sanctum door (20, 24) to (20, 22), talk to Garland, and defeat him in battle
milestones.then: Garland is defeated (106 HP -> 0 HP) and Princess Sara is rescued
